source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 319 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 319 was established by Ordinance No. 20421, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 23, 1989. Ordinance No. 20421 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 319 is established on property generally located along the north line of West Commerce Street, west of the west line of Vilbig Road. The size of PD 319 is approximately 2.978 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 319A). (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.105. USES.

The following uses are permitted on the Property:

(1) Metal salvage facility.

(2) Outside salvage or reclamation use.

(3) Any use permitted in an IM Industrial/Manufacturing District. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.106. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

(a) Except as provided below, the development standards of the IM Industrial/Manufacturing District apply to the Property.

(b) No minimum distance is required between a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use on the Property and an R, R(A), D, D(A), TH, TH(A), MF, MF(A), MH, or MH(A)

district. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking and loading for each use must be provided in accordance with the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.108. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan. All landscaping must be installed within six months of August 23, 1989. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.109. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII, except that non-premise signs are prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.110. FENCES.

No fence in the required front yard may exceed 12 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.111. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.112. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.113. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-319.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 319 is located on Zoning Map No. K-6. (Ord. Nos. 20421; 25850)
